_comment: Age-gating policy for agentic CLI binaries devcontainer-agentic-clis installs globally via npm. One entry per binary; run-age-gate.sh reads this file directly. Replace every <placeholder> before use. MCP servers are NOT listed here -- their age-policy already lives in devcontainer-agentic-clis' own mcp-servers.manifest.json (minimumReleaseAgeDays per server), read directly by run-age-gate.sh at the fixed path documented in this Skill's SKILL.md.

<self-updating-cli-key>._comment: This CLI ships its own updater with no discoverable disable flag and no way for this container to control update timing. minimumReleaseAgeDays does not apply: there is no update decision to gate, only drift to detect. baselineVersion is recorded once when the CLI is first wired up; run-age-gate.sh compares it against '<binary> --version' every cycle and logs a warning on mismatch instead of holding or installing anything.
